# Top TRT

> Top TRT (toptrt.io) is an independent comparison publisher for online testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) clinics in the US. We rank and review licensed telehealth providers on testing, treatment options, price, support and value. All editorial is compliance-minded: TRT is prescription-only and clinician-directed, requires blood tests confirming clinically low testosterone, and is not an enhancement product for men with normal levels.

## Compare & providers
- [Best Online TRT Clinics (comparison)](https://www.toptrt.io/): Ranked comparison of the top online TRT clinics.
- [All provider reviews](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews): In-depth reviews of each TRT clinic.
- [Hone Health review](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews/hone): Testing-first, physician-guided TRT (our top pick).
- [TMates review](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews/tmates): Dedicated TRT-focused telehealth membership.
- [Male Excel review](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews/maleexcel): Established brand; at-home labs, injections or cream, unlimited follow-ups.
- [Taurus Meds review](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews/taurus): Men's-health telehealth offering TRT.
- [Dude Meds review](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews/dudemeds): Value-minded men's telehealth.
- [Fridays review](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews/fridays): Men's-health telehealth offering TRT.
- [Brightmeds review](https://www.toptrt.io/reviews/brightmeds): Highly-rated online telehealth prescription service (4.7 on Trustpilot).

## Key guides
- [TRT: The Complete Guide to Testosterone Replacement Therapy (2026)](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/trt-guide): In-depth pillar guide covering what TRT is, diagnosis, benefits, risks, delivery methods, cost, online TRT, choosing a clinic, monitoring and alternatives.
- [What is TRT? Meaning & how it works](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/what-is-trt)
- [TRT results timeline: what to expect week by week and month by month](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/trt-results-timeline): When libido, energy, mood, muscle, fat loss and bone density typically change on TRT, and how bloodwork confirms progress.
- [How to get TRT online](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/how-to-get-trt-online)
- [Online doctors that prescribe testosterone](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/online-doctors-that-prescribe-testosterone)

- [Is TRT safe? TRAVERSE trial & the 2025 FDA label change explained](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/is-trt-safe): Evidence-based look at TRT safety - what the TRAVERSE cardiovascular trial found, why the FDA removed the heart-risk boxed warning and added a blood-pressure warning, and the real risks monitoring is designed to catch.
- [TRT and fertility](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/trt-and-fertility)
- [Signs of low testosterone](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/signs-of-low-testosterone)
- [Testosterone levels by age: normal ranges, charts & what they mean](https://www.toptrt.io/articles/testosterone-levels-by-age): Normal total/free testosterone ranges by age, how levels change from puberty to older age, why age charts disagree, and what counts as low.
